scientific_integrity: Analytic proof establishes statements for all positive decay parameters; finite standard-library consistency checks do not certify the infinite quantifiers. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only continuous asymmetric two-sided exponential kernels and unweighted translates of the integer grid; no arbitrary totally positive function, irregular grid, or quantitative Gabor frame bound is covered. Classical exact sampling formula overlap remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp shifted sampling bounds and two tight phases for asymmetric two-sided exponentials
